title: Stability for the stochastic heat equation with multiplicative noise via finite-dimensional feedback
summary: In this paper, we study the long-time behavior of a stochastic heat equation with a class of infinite-dimensional multiplicative noises and localized control. We first illustrate through simple examples of the uncontrolled dynamics that mean-square and almost sure exponential stability may hold under different conditions on the parameters, reflecting the interplay between the drift and the multiplicative noise.
